sections.title: Life cycle and habitat
sections.text: In this catalogue, Geranium refers to Geranium robertianum, an aromatic annual or biennial herb reaching about 60 cm. It grows in woodland, margins, rocky places and disturbed sites.

sections.title: Leaves, flowers and fruit
sections.text: Often red, sticky stems carry deeply divided leaves. The small pink flowers have five petals and often occur in pairs; the elongated beaked fruit splits into five parts when ripe.

sections.title: Toxicity
sections.text: The botanical source consulted does not report toxicity. This is not evidence of food use.
